practice_units.title: Mapping Cultural Influence
practice_units.problem: Give examples of how different cultures have influenced Indian food and architecture.
guidance: Think about the Mughal influence on architecture (e.g., domes, arches).
Consider the introduction of chillies or potatoes by Europeans.
Look at regional variations in clothing like the Saree or Lungi.
practice_units.solution: Architecture: Use of arches and minarets; Food: Introduction of various spices and vegetables from outside; Language: Loan words in local dialects.
